documents.title: Services Offered
documents.content:
## Dine-in Service
Our dine-in service includes a full menu of fresh pasta, wood-fired pizzas, and other Italian favorites. Reservations are available for parties of all sizes. We strive to provide a warm and welcoming atmosphere for all our guests.

## Takeout Service
Our takeout service allows you to enjoy our delicious Italian dishes from the comfort of your own home. Simply call ahead to place your order and we will have it ready for pickup at your convenience.

## Catering Service
Our catering service is perfect for parties, events, and business meetings. We offer a variety of options to fit your needs, including pasta stations, pizza bars, and full-service catering. Our experienced staff will work with you to create a customized menu that fits your budget and preferences.

## Weekend Brunch
Join us for weekend brunch, featuring a special menu of Italian-inspired dishes, including eggs, pancakes, and quiche. Brunch is served from 9am - 3pm on Saturdays and Sundays.

documents.title: Pricing Information
documents.content:
## Pasta Dishes
Spaghetti Bolognese: $18
Fettuccine Alfredo: $19
Vegetarian Lasagna: $17
Gluten-free options available for $2 extra.

## Wood-fired Pizzas
Margherita Pizza: $15
Quattro Formaggi Pizza: $18
Meat Lover's Pizza: $20
Vegan options available for $2 extra.

## Specials and Bundles
Happy Hour: 2-for-1 drinks and discounted appetizers from 5pm - 7pm daily.
Lunch Special: Choose from a selection of sandwiches, salads, and soups for $10 - $12.
Dinner for Two: A three-course meal for two people, including wine and dessert, for $60.

documents.title: Business Policies
documents.content:
## Cancellation Policy
We require a 24-hour notice for cancellations. If you need to cancel your reservation, please call us at least 24 hours in advance to avoid a $20 per person fee.

## Payment
We accept all major credit cards, cash, and contactless payments. For parties of 10 or more, a $50 deposit is required at booking and one check is provided per table.

## Late Arrival Policy
If you arrive more than 15 minutes late for your reservation, we may need to seat you at a different table or wait until the next available seating time.

## Refund Policy
If you are not satisfied with your meal, please let us know and we will work with you to resolve the issue. Refunds are available on a case-by-case basis.

documents.title: Frequently Asked Questions
documents.content:
Q: Do you have gluten-free options?
A: Yes, we have a variety of gluten-free options available, including pasta dishes and pizzas.

Q: Can I make a reservation for a large party?
A: Yes, we can accommodate parties of up to 20 people. Please call ahead to make a reservation.

Q: Do you have vegan options?
A: Yes, we have a variety of vegan options available, including pasta dishes and pizzas.

Q: Can I order takeout online?
A: No, we currently only accept takeout orders over the phone or in person.

Q: Do you have a kids' menu?
A: Yes, we have a kids' menu available for children under the age of 12.

Q: Can I bring my own wine?
A: No, we have a full bar and do not allow outside wine or liquor.

Q: Do you have parking available?
A: Yes, we have a small parking lot available for our guests.

Q: Can I get a refund if I don't like my meal?
A: Yes, we offer refunds on a case-by-case basis if you are not satisfied with your meal.

Q: Do you have wheelchair accessibility?
A: Yes, our restaurant is wheelchair accessible.

documents.title: Tone and Voice Guide
documents.content:
At Nonna Rosa Trattoria, we strive to provide a warm and welcoming atmosphere for all our guests. Here are some guidelines for our tone and voice:
Do: Use a friendly and approachable tone, be knowledgeable about our menu and services, and always be willing to help.
Don't: Use a formal or stuffy tone, be dismissive or rude to guests, or use overly technical language.
Example sign-off: 'Grazie mille for dining with us! We hope to see you again soon.'
